current.text: Memphis projects him as a bench player. The projected starters are Ty Jerome, Cedric Coward, Jerami Grant, Cameron Boozer and Zach Edey.
Memphis expects to use an 11 or 12 man rotation, and coach Tuomas Iisalo plays short stints and keeps minutes down. That limits minutes for bench forwards.
He is eligible for a contract extension but has not been extended.
One expert expects him to get some playing time, possibly at small forward.
Do not draft him. Too many players rank ahead of him for him to have real value.
Memphis plays 4 games in each of our three playoff weeks under the March 28 end. It has only 13 back-to-backs, possibly the fewest in the league.
